raw.rationale: Eugenol is a weak, non-selective phenolic compound with an annotated AR-antagonist mechanism, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to produce lineage-selective killing; only prostate/AR-dependent lineages would be plausible, and prostate is not among the listed lineages. Published PRISM-type screens show most compounds are selective for no lineage, so probabilities are kept near the low base rate with slight elevation for AR-expressing breast and urinary tract lineages.
